title: Prism Crush — Shatter the Crystal Depths
description: Prism Crush is a classic falling-block puzzle rebuilt as a hand-painted crystal cavern. Same 13×20 board, same ten non-standard gem shapes, same arrows-only controls — but every settled block sits in a chiselled socket, and the cavern repaints itself as you mine deeper through four glowing strata. Clear rows to shatter them, chain 1-to-4 line scores, and chase your own best score. Free in your browser, no download.

title: Prism Karts: Knockout Cup
description: Blast rivals with rockets and bombs, drift for turbo boosts, and survive three knockout rounds across 54 prism arenas to lift the cup.

title: Prism Shift 3D
description: Prism Shift 3D is a 3×3 wrap-around sliding picture puzzle with a memory twist. Watch the board get shuffled row by row and column by column, then swipe to put the picture back. Twelve hand-illustrated worlds — cosmic launch, coral reef, neon city, lava forge, star whale — each one faster than the last. No blank tiles, no sliding a single piece: you shift whole rows and columns, and they loop around. Free in your browser, portrait-friendly.

title: QUIZ RUSH — Free Trivia Game Show
description: Ten fast questions on a neon quiz-show stage. Build a streak to trigger OVERDRIVE, double your score, and chase three stars across three shows.

title: Ragdoll Frontline — Free 3D Ragdoll Battlefield Shooter
description: Ragdoll Frontline is a free browser-based 3D third-person battlefield defense shooter. You're a lone soldier holding the line across 16 realistic battlefields — desert highways, old-town ruins, frozen outposts, steel yards and black-rain nights — against wave after wave of enemy infantry. Every kill tumbles into full ragdoll physics: shotgun blasts and grenades launch bodies through the air. Every fourth operation brings a boss war vehicle, and between waves you spend requisition points on weapons, gadgets and permanent upgrades. No download, no install, no login.

title: Ranger vs Zombies
description: Ranger vs Zombies is an exciting zombie defense shooter. Control your ranger, fend off endless zombie waves and protect your base from being overrun.

title: RED FORTRESS — 赤色要塞 · Jeep Rescue Shooter
description: Drive the last jeep into the red fortress, rescue a chain of POWs, and call in a gunship airstrike. Free top-down vehicle shooter in your browser.

title: Reef Blitz: Deep Sea Hunt
description: Reef Blitz: Deep Sea Hunt is a free arcade fishing shooter that runs straight from your browser. A brass harpoon cannon sits at the foot of the screen — swing it with the mouse, your finger or the arrow keys and pick which passing shoal is worth the next shot. Every harpoon costs coins and only a limited number are loaded, each reef has a haul quota to fill, and the purse belongs to that reef alone. Ten reefs, seven net powers, two abyss bosses and a golden coin-fish worth 400. No download, no account, no install.

title: Ringbound: Tangle Atelier
description: Ringbound is a hand-built 3D clay puzzle about the quiet pleasure of untangling. Turn clay rings, sweep their gaps across bronze clasps, free every loop on the potters' tray and shatter three Warden bosses. 30 levels, three assist tools, English and Chinese — all in a calm, sunny workshop. Free in your browser.

title: Royal Spider Solitaire — Free Classic Spider Solitaire Card Game
description: Royal Spider Solitaire is the classic Spider Solitaire dressed in a regal casino theme — an elegant deep-green velvet table, gold-trimmed cards and wine-red patterned backs. Assemble same-suit K-to-A runs, collect all eight and claim the table. It comes with a guided tutorial, three difficulty tiers, undo, hints, combo scoring and polished motion, and it runs right in your browser on desktop or mobile — no download, no install, no account.

title: Serpina — Greenhouse Serpent
description: Serpina is a sleek neon twist on the classic snake game. Guide the glowing serpent across the grid, collect glowing orbs to grow longer. Avoid hitting the walls or your own trail. Survive and rack up points as the game speeds up.

title: SKY BLASTER —— Game Fact Sheet
description: Sky Blaster is a landscape shoot-'em-up web game with a charming Western cartoon art style. Pilot your red mini fighter through fluffy macaron clouds, auto-fire at waves of red scouts, green gunners and purple bombers, and take down three unique bosses: the Sky Cruiser, the Twin Fortress and the Dark Flagship "Night Owl". 8 levels each introducing a genuinely different mechanic, then endless looping with rising difficulty for high-score and longest-combo runs. Free in your browser, no download,

title: SKY BUDDIES
description: Sky Buddies is a friendly plane shooter where you fly solo or team up with a buddy on the same screen. Dodge incoming enemy bullets, grab weapon upgrades, blast enemy squadrons and take down powerful sky bosses. Simple drag controls make it easy for all ages to jump into the aerial battle.

title: Sky Buddies
description: Sky Buddies is a cute aerial shooting game. Fly together with your buddy in the starry sky. Dodge enemy bullets, collect power-ups, destroy enemy waves and take down huge sky bosses. Simple controls make it easy for players of all ages to enjoy the flight battle.

title: Sky Buddies: Cloud Patrol
description: Sky Buddies: Cloud Patrol is a free 3D cartoon vertical plane shooter for your browser. Fly a round little bear in a red-and-cream propeller plane above candy clouds, steer past frog, pig, cat and owl squadrons while your cannons fire by themselves, grab bullet orbs that swap your gun, evolve through five flight ranks, and fight a different sky pirate flagship every fourth wave. No download, no account — one tap and you're airborne.

title: Skyfang Strike
description: Skyfang Strike is a thrilling aerial shoot'em up. Pilot your fighter, dodge enemy fire and blast waves of foes out of the sky!

title: Steel Vanguard — Frontline Tank Defense
description:
Pilot the Vanguard main battle tank and hold the front against endless
enemy air fleets! Blast recon drones, dodge plasma shells, catch airdrop
crates and destroy the siege airship Kessler. A free arcade defense game
by Pipy Games — no download, no install, plays right in your browser.

title: Stick Monkey
description:
Stick Monkey rebuilds the classic "measure it, drop it, cross it" one-touch game
with a new hero: a young monkey king carrying the golden staff. Press and hold
and the staff grows out of the pillar under his feet. Let go and it topples
forward into a bridge — if you judged the length right, he walks across. Too
short or too long and the abyss wins.

title: Stickman Dismount
description: Stickman Dismount is a fun ragdoll physics simulation game. Launch your stickman, watch him tumble, bounce and crash through ramps, stairs and obstacles. Enjoy funny, chaotic physics moments and relax!

title: Stryke Arena — Free Browser FPS Arena Shooter
description: Stryke Arena is a fast, single-player first-person shooter that runs straight in your browser — no download, no login, no install. You're an independent operative dropped into hostile arenas across four warzones: a desert outpost, dusk-time urban ruins, an arctic convoy yard and a fortified night canyon. Militia squads attack in waves, and every fourth stage an armored boss commander takes the field — Dustdevil, Ironjaw, Frostbite and finally Goliath Prime. Three upgradeable weapons, an AI squad that fights beside you, and a meta-progression that makes every run count.

title: Sushi Sensei Memory — A Kawaii Conveyor-Belt Matching Game
description: A warm little sushi bar, forty hand-painted plates of nigiri, maki and tempura - find every pair before the kitchen clock or your flip budget runs out, then out-match Head Chef Tanuki.

title: SWAT vs Zombies
description: SWAT vs Zombies is an intense top-down zombie shooter. Control a heavily armed SWAT officer, clear infected areas, survive endless zombie waves, upgrade your weapons and restore order to the city.

title: Tank Wars
description: Tank Wars: Steel Front is a thrilling tank combat game. Pilot your armored tank across the battlefield, destroy enemy tanks, dodge incoming shells and dominate the steel front.

title: THE CUBE 3D — Free 3D Rubik's Cube Puzzle in Your Browser
description: THE CUBE 3D is a high-quality web remake of the classic 3D Rubik's Cube puzzle, rendered in real time with WebGL — rounded stickers, silky plastic materials and true-to-life lighting under studio-grade three-point lights. It ships with 2x2, 3x3 and 4x4 cube sizes, three flip feels, adjustable scramble length, orthographic and perspective cameras, and seven color themes. A built-in timer, move counter and full stats board track your best, and unfinished games resume anytime. No downloads, no interruptions — play instantly in your browser on desktop or mobile.

title: TopSpin World Tour — Free Online Table Tennis Game | PipyGames
description: TopSpin World Tour is a free online table tennis game with true 11-point ITTF rules. Climb a 56-opponent World Tour ladder, fight through a 6-round knockout Tournament, or jump into a Quick Match against the world. One-finger controls: move your mouse (or finger) to steer the paddle, click to serve, and let your swing decide the  angle and power of every shot. Realistic physics, a floodlit night arena, and 57 national flags to represent.

title: Turbo Bumper Cup - Neon Hover Arena Soccer
description: Drive a neon hover pod, ram the glowing energy core into the rival gate, and win the cup across 24 stages.

title: Turbo Moto Rush — Free 3D Motorcycle Racing Game
description: Turbo Moto Rush is a free 3D arcade motorcycle racer that runs straight in your browser — no download, no launcher, no account. Ride a four-lane highway at up to 401 km/h, threading between sedans, SUVs, vans, trucks and buses, and every car you scrape past at full lean pays a near miss that feeds an x8 combo multiplier and your wallet. Sixteen original routes mix time-trials, head-to-head races against five tiers of AI bikers, and four boss fights against giant armoured haulers you beat by overtaking them clean while ramming their armour with nitro. Cash buys five bikes and four upgrade tracks, and when the campaign's done, Endless Sprint keeps generating traffic that thickens every 900 metres.

title: VELVET RUNWAY — Fashion Week Dress Up & Style Game
description: Step into the spotlight and rule all 50 fashion-week styling challenges. Mix dresses, hair, makeup and accessories, then watch the judges score your look from head to toe. VELVET RUNWAY is a free browser dress up game with a full wardrobe, runway themes, and a shareable style card for every makeover. No download, no account — just pick, style, and strut.

title: Viking Clash — Real-Time Card Battle Tower Defense
description: Viking Clash is a free real-time card-battle tower-defense web game set in the world of Norse Vikings. Lead your Viking clan into a fierce 3-minute siege in the fjord arena: play cards to summon warriors and spells, destroy the rival tribe's towers and defend your own King Tower. Two bespoke Viking-boss fights await on stages 5 and 10. No download, no account — a compact quick-fire campaign that runs right in your browser.

title: Viking Escape
description: Viking Escape is a fast-paced running adventure game. Help the brave viking run, jump and dodge dangers on his way to escape.

title: Voltroll — Morph Truck & Energy Ball Physics Racing | Free Online Game
description: Voltroll is a free browser physics driving game. Blast a monster truck across 50 wild tracks in 5 hand-crafted biomes — rainforest, desert, glacier, volcano and neon canyon. Watch your energy: crates, spikes and stumps cost you. Reach the goal distance to clear each level, collect coins and gems to refill nitro and upgrade your garage: engine, tires, energy tank, nitro and ball core. No download, no install — play instantly in your browser.

title: VoxStrike Arena - Free Voxel FPS Deathmatch | Pipygames
description: VoxStrike Arena is a fast-paced voxel first-person shooter! Jump into container-packed arenas and battle a squad of AI soldiers in 50 action-packed missions. Pick your loadout — assault rifle, SMG, shotgun, sniper or pistol — sprint, slide and strafe through cover, land headshots for double damage, and hit the kill goal before the timer runs out. Every mission you clear unlocks the next and earns up to 3 stars. Are you the toughest soldier on the block?

title: War Machine
description: War Machine is an exciting mech combat shooter. Control a powerful battle mech, blast enemy units, collect upgrades and crush all foes on the battlefield.

title: WIND-UP KID — 2.5D Toy-Box Platformer
description: Run, stomp and fireball your way through a wooden toy box in this free 2.5D platformer — three levels, tight jumps, instant browser play.

title: Wood Screw: Bolts Puzzle - Unscrew Screws & Drop All Planks
description: Wood Screw: Bolts Puzzle is a satisfying wooden brain teaser. Tap a screw to select it, then tap an empty hole - the screw flies over and lands there. Every move eats up a free hole, and a plank with no screws left comes crashing down, releasing new holes. Run out of empty holes and it's game over! Fallen planks can rest on others and block the holes beneath them - so choose your order wisely. Clear all planks before the timer runs out across 60 hand-tuned levels of increasing difficulty. Stuck?

title: Zombie Buster
description: Zombie Buster is a fast top-down zombie survival shooter. Fight against endless undead hordes, unlock powerful weapons, pick up upgrades, and stay alive through increasingly brutal waves. Clear the arena and become the ultimate zombie buster!

title: Zombie Duck
description: Zombie Duck Hunter is a funny zombie duck shooting game. Take your gun, shoot down weird zombie ducks flying across the sky and stop them from reaching you.
